name: Sugar-Free Biscuit
description: A 'sugar-free' packaged biscuit containing hidden carbohydrate additives.
ingredients: Wheat flour, maltodextrin, vegetable oil, milk solids, salt, leavening agents (sodium bicarbonate, ammonium bicarbonate), artificial flavors
notes: Classic VERIFY/CAUTION demo — marketed as sugar-free but contains maltodextrin (high GI carbohydrate).

name: Instant Noodles
description: Packaged instant noodles with high sodium seasoning.
ingredients: Wheat flour, palm oil, salt, monosodium glutamate (MSG), soy sauce powder, spices, sodium benzoate (preservative), artificial flavors, caramel color
notes: HIGH RISK for hypertension/CKD due to extreme sodium. Also wheat allergen.

name: Spice Mix
description: A packaged spice blend with unspecified vegetable protein source.
ingredients: Coriander, cumin, turmeric, red chili, salt, vegetable protein, natural flavors, silicon dioxide (anti-caking agent)
notes: VERIFY demo — contains 'vegetable protein' with unspecified source (could be peanut/soy/wheat).

name: Milk Chocolate
description: Standard milk chocolate bar with cocoa, milk solids, and sugar.
ingredients: Sugar, cocoa butter, milk solids, cocoa mass, whey powder, soy lecithin, vanilla extract, salt
notes: HIGH RISK for milk allergy. CAUTION for diabetes/PCOS due to high added sugar.

name: Packaged Juice
description: Commercially packaged fruit juice with added sugar.
ingredients: Reconstituted fruit juice (60%), water, sugar, citric acid, ascorbic acid (vitamin C), sodium benzoate (preservative), artificial flavors, beta-carotene (color)
notes: CAUTION for diabetes/PCOS — high added sugar despite 'juice' label.

name: Protein Bar
description: Packaged protein bar with whey protein and added sweeteners.
ingredients: Whey protein concentrate, glucose syrup, palm kernel oil, milk chocolate coating (sugar, cocoa butter, whole milk powder, cocoa mass, soy lecithin), peanut flour, almonds, salt, soy protein isolate, natural flavors
notes: HIGH RISK for peanut/milk/soy/tree nut allergies. CAUTION for diabetes.

name: Breakfast Cereal
description: Fortified breakfast cereal with whole grains and added sugar.
ingredients: Whole wheat flour, sugar, rice flour, maltodextrin, salt, niacinamide, reduced iron, zinc oxide, pyridoxine hydrochloride, riboflavin, thiamine mononitrate, folic acid, BHT (preservative)
notes: CAUTION for diabetes — high added sugar + maltodextrin. Wheat allergen.

name: Salad Dressing
description: Commercial salad dressing with hidden sodium and unspecified natural flavors.
ingredients: Soybean oil, water, vinegar, salt, sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, natural flavors, xanthan gum, calcium disodium EDTA, sodium benzoate
notes: CAUTION for hypertension (high sodium). VERIFY for allergen-sensitive users (natural flavors unspecified).
